cand.title: GDPM 2027: 10th International Workshop on Grapevine Downy and Powdery Mildews
cand.excerpt: Strong event evidence; venue commitment reduces current access but supports targeted overflow/future capture.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: No named GDPM 2027 accommodation buyer, event manager or authorized signatory was verified. The official event contact is info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch. Katia Gindro is a verified Agroscope mycology leader and relevant institutional referral; Olivier Viret is a scientific-network referral identified by an official Agroscope article as a DGAV centre head, not a verified current Agroscope buyer. Neither has a verified 2027 committee role or hotel-contract authority. Two verified named event buyers could not be established.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming 10th edition: 13–16 July 2027, Nyon, Switzerland, within the requested horizon. These are workshop activity dates, not the Agroscope announcement publication date of 5 October 2026. No officially announced edition after 2027 was found.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specification: this is a geographically relevant Nyon / La Côte research workshop, not downtown-Geneva megashow housing. YOTEL Geneva Lake in Founex could suit a modest accommodation subset, breakfast, and optional informal gathering, provided delegates accept the transfer to Changins and organizers permit an additional hotel. The main sessions are already allocated to the Aula, so do not sell the hotel as an uncommitted main venue. Scientific/institutional convenience matters more than resort amenities. With no 2027 attendance or lodging volume published in the reviewed sources, neither a 20–120-room block nor use of the whole 237-room hotel is justified. Do not infer hotel demand from the hotel meeting-room capacity.
findings.venueCommitments: The official event site states: “The workshop will be held at Agroscope Changins”; precise venue: Agroscope Changins – Aula, Route de Duillier 52, 1260 Nyon, Switzerland. Territory: Nyon / La Côte, canton of Vaud; not Geneva city or Lausanne. This is an announced institutional meeting venue, not a competing hotel or evidence that accommodation is fully contracted. The general Changins campus page gives Route de Duillier 60; use the edition-specific Aula address 52 for this event.
findings.historicalRotation: International, institution-led rotation since 1991, not an annual Nyon event. Documented hosts include Geneva, New York; Freiburg; Loxton; California; San Michele; Bordeaux; Vitoria-Gasteiz; Corvallis; Cremona; and Nyon. Official retrospective summaries contain historical inconsistencies: 2002 Davis versus Napa, and 2009/2013 in the retrospective versus contemporaneous 2010/2014 proceedings/reporting. These are flagged in the timeline rather than treated as separate editions. The published three-to-four-year description is not a guarantee: 2022 to 2027 is five years.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Pre-reserved accommodation exists: the official event homepage states “Deadline for booking pre-reserved hotel rooms: 31 March 2027” and “Fees, payment and accommodation details are available on the Practical Information page.” No edition-specific hotel name could be verified in the accessible official material; therefore the verified named-hotel list is empty, not evidence that no hotels are reserved. The linked Practical Information page could not be retrieved. Hotel-direct versus organizer-managed booking, a housing bureau, room quantities, rates, release terms, and any open RFP remain unknown. General inquiry route: info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch. Do not mark lodging sourcing open or fully committed elsewhere.
findings.organizationStructure: Agroscope is explicitly the 2027 organizer. It is the Swiss agricultural research centre affiliated with the Federal Office for Agriculture, not an association, PCO, DMC or commercial event agency. Agroscope Changins is the host institution/venue. Sciencesconf supplies the published event/registration pages; this does not establish procurement or housing authority. No separate legal series owner, appointed PCO, DMC or housing bureau was verified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: A campus meeting venue is fixed and pre-reserved hotel rooms already exist, creating a possible incumbent-accommodation disadvantage. Incumbent hotels, exclusivity, sold-out conditions, unmet demand, and overflow have not been verified. Historical size is variable: the 2017 report states thirty delegates and specifically calls this unusually small; the 2022 announcement says more than 50 attendees had enrolled. Neither figure forecasts 2027 rooms or attendance. A Founex hotel would need a credible transfer proposition; no event shuttle or YOTEL booking relationship was found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch now, ahead of the published 31 March 2027 accommodation booking deadline. Request referral to the named logistics/accommodation decision-maker and ask for the Practical Information accommodation sheet: all reserved hotels, allocations, rates, booking method, release dates, exclusivity, expected residential attendance and ability to add another hotel. If additional lodging is welcome, propose a small demand-led allotment within the supplied commercial band, with breakfast and a costed Founex–Changins transfer option; size only after evidence of need. Ask Katia Gindro only for an internal referral if the event inbox does not route the inquiry. Do not submit an unsolicited main-venue replacement or claim overflow. Record other Agroscope local meetings separately from future GDPM editions.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For 2027, conditional supplemental/preferred-lodging access only, not qualified open sourcing. The 31 March 2027 pre-reserved-room booking deadline is still ahead as of 16 November 2026, but it is not a supplier tender deadline and does not demonstrate that another hotel can join. Ask whether additions, independent delegate bookings, or a speaker/organizer subset are permitted. No actual overflow demand is established.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: stronger as Agroscope/Changins account development and possible later locally hosted workshops than as an assumed next GDPM hotel win. Historical international rotation means the next GDPM may leave the region. No next-edition dates, destination or hotel procurement window after 2027 were verified; do not manufacture a 2030/2031 cycle or assume a return to Nyon.
